title: The Last Ember Anew
author: Vesper Crane
blurb: Wendell Quintana, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
